facts.business: Sarda Proteins Limited operated as a BSE-listed trading entity focused on distribution of solar modules, photovoltaic components and renewable energy equipment during FY26, while simultaneously pivoting toward an integrated agricultural, horticultural and food-processing platform through acquisitions and capital raising.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Board approved a rights issue of up to ₹90 Crore, with ₹70 Crore of net proceeds earmarked for controlling (>51%) stakes in Fresita Food and Urja Protein

key_risks: Financial statements describe legacy solar-trading business while disclosures describe agri pivot — distance between the two is the most useful thing MD&A can quantify
Agri strategy is disclosed, funded and directionally underway, but its operating and financial imprint on FY26 numbers is minimal
Governance transition: Board and senior management reconstituted; statutory committees re-formed; FY26 audited accounts signed by Managing Director and CFO who had already left office
